description: The select case for React (value with onChange): options from a list and a conditional option, a disabled option, an uncontrolled select (option values from collapsed text), programmatic values, keyboard changes on a focused closed select (arrows skipping disabled options, Home, End, typeahead). React differs from Svelte where the state and the options disagree: React DOM shows a value no option has as the first enabled option (updateOptions), not as none, also after the shown option is removed; and a select whose onChange writes no state is restored right after the change (restoreControlledState): the handler sees the picked value, the select snaps back
